name: escudero-sanz-1999-media
citation: Escudero-Sanz I, Navarro R. Off-axis aberrations of a wide-angle schematic eye model. J Opt Soc Am A 16(8):1881-1891, 1999. Table 2 (refractive indices of the ocular media at four wavelengths).
note: Transcribed 2026-10-28 from two search-engine excerpts of Table 2 that agree (the 543 nm column is also quoted by a later study using the model); the paper itself was unreachable from the cloud session. Set verified: true after comparing with the paper. The 589.3 nm column equals the Navarro 1985 indices stored in navarro-1985.json.
model: Each medium's dispersion is a three-term Cauchy fit n(λ) = A + B/λ² + C/λ⁴ (λ in µm) to the four values, a modeling choice (web/packages/eye-model/src/optics/dispersion.ts). Only differences from 555 nm are applied: n(λ) = index555 + [n_fit(λ) − n_fit(555)], so each document keeps its own 555 nm index.
